Select IC50 activity rows for human Lysine-specific histone demethylase 1A (CHEMBL6136). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL6136 and standard_type IC50. Do not deduplicate; return all activity rows.
